arabic_blocks: [290] حدثنا علي بن عبد الله قال : حدثنا سفيان قال : سمعت عبد الرحمن بن القاسم قال : سمعت القاسم يقول : سمعت عائشة تقول خرجنا لا نرى إلا الحج فلما كنا بسرف حضت فدخل علي رسول الله ﷺ وأنا أبكي قال : ما لك أنفست قلت : نعم قال إن هذا أمر كتبه الله على بنات آدم فاقضي ما يقضي الحاج غير أن لا تطوفي بالبيت قالت وضحى رسول الله ﷺ عن نسائه بالبقر
english_blocks: ‘Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah related to us. He said: Sufyan related to us. He said: I heard ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim. He said: I heard al-Qasim saying: I heard ‘A’ishah saying:

We set out intending only the Hajj. When we were at Sarif, I menstruated. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came in to me while I was crying. He said: “What is the matter with you? Have you begun menstruating?” I said: “Yes.” He said: “This is a matter Allah has ordained for the daughters of Adam. Perform what the pilgrim performs, except that you must not circumambulate the House.” She said: “The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, sacrificed cattle on behalf of his wives.”
entries.english_status: Personal prototype: AI-assisted working translation; two Arabic printed witnesses and two English translation families compared. Independent Arabic, English and context review pending.

notes: The complete opening chain includes all three explicit I heard statements. The closing sacrifice statement remains part of Aisha’s account. Cattle renders the Arabic collective البقر; the Bewley body uses a singular cow, while the EPUB uses cows. No geographic distance is imported from the EPUB explanation.

The selected digital text and historical print place this report within the opening chapter. The modern print and Bewley insert a further heading before it. Their differing chapter division is documented, not imposed on the selected source. The separately preserved book quotation and chapter introduction are outside sessions.

arabic_blocks: [291] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال : حدثنا مالك عن هشام بن عروة عن أبيه عن عائشة قالت كنت أرجل رأس رسول الله ﷺ وأنا حائض
english_blocks: ‘Abd Allah ibn Yusuf related to us. He said: Malik related to us, from Hisham ibn ‘Urwah, from his father, from ‘A’ishah, who said:
I used to comb the head of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, while I was menstruating.
entries.english_status: Personal prototype: AI-assisted working translation; two Arabic printed witnesses and two English translation families compared. Independent Arabic, English and context review pending.

notes: The selected digital and modern print use حدثنا for Malik; the historical print uses أخبرنا. The selected related to us is retained, without normalizing the reporting verb to the other edition. The full chain and first-person narration remain.

arabic_blocks: [292] حدثنا إبراهيم بن موسى قال : أخبرنا هشام بن يوسف ان ابن جريج أخبرهم قال : أخبرني هشام عن عروة أنه سئل أتخدمني الحائض أو تدنو مني المرأة وهي جنب ، فقال عروة كل ذلك علي هين وكل ذلك تخدمني وليس على أحد في ذلك بأس أخبرتني عائشة أنها كانت ترجل تعني رأس رسول الله ﷺ وهي حائض ورسول الله ﷺ حينئذ مجاور في المسجد يدني لها رأسه وهي في حجرتها فترجله وهي حائض
english_blocks: Ibrahim ibn Musa related to us. He said: Hisham ibn Yusuf informed us that Ibn Jurayj informed them. He said: Hisham informed me, from ‘Urwah, that he was asked:

“May a menstruating woman serve me, or may a woman come close to me while she is in janabah?” ‘Urwah said: “All of that is easy for me, and in all of that she serves me, and there is no harm in that for anyone.”
‘A’ishah informed me that

She used to comb—meaning the head of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace—while she was menstruating. The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, was at that time staying in retreat in the mosque. He would bring his head close to her while she was in her chamber, and she would comb it while she was menstruating.
entries.english_status: Personal prototype: AI-assisted working translation; two Arabic printed witnesses and two English translation families compared. Independent Arabic, English and context review pending.

notes: Both the question to Urwah and his answer remain before the embedded Aisha attribution. The source wording repeats all of that and menstruating; neither repetition is removed. The source’s explanatory تعني remains as meaning, without assigning it to a named speaker not specified here.

The embedded Aisha attribution is a separate chain segment, not a new numbered hadith. The entire original paragraph, including repeated honorifics and chamber/retreat details, remains in display and narration order.

The historical print begins Hisham ibn Yusuf with حدثنا where the digital and modern print have أخبرنا. It also adds the separate gloss مجاور معتكف after this report; that gloss is absent from the selected paragraph and modern body. Neither difference is silently imported.

english_blocks: Abu Nu‘aym al-Fadl ibn Dukayn related to us; he heard Zuhayr, from Mansur ibn Safiyyah, that his mother related to him that ‘A’ishah related to her:
That the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, used to recline in my lap while I was menstruating, then recite the Quran.

arabic_blocks: [294] حدثنا المكي بن إبراهيم قال : حدثنا هشام عن يحيى بن أبي كثير عن أبي سلمة أن زينب بنت أم سلمة حدثته أن أم سلمة حدثتها قالت بينا أنا مع النبي ﷺ مضطجعة في خميصة إذ حضت فانسللت فأخذت ثياب حيضتي قال أنفست قلت : نعم فدعاني فاضطجعت معه في الخميلة
english_blocks: Al-Makki ibn Ibrahim related to us. He said: Hisham related to us, from Yahya ibn Abi Kathir, from Abu Salamah, that Zaynab bint Umm Salamah related to him that Umm Salamah related to her. She said:

While I was lying with the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, in a patterned cloak, I began menstruating. I slipped away and took my menstrual garments. He said: “Have you begun menstruating?” I said: “Yes.” He called me, and I lay down with him in the fringed covering.

arabic_blocks: [295] حدثنا قبيصة قال : حدثنا سفيان عن منصور عن إبراهيم عن الأسود عن عائشة قالت كنت أغتسل أنا والنبي ﷺ من إناء واحد كلانا جنب وكان يأمرني فأتزر فيباشرني وأنا حائض وكان يخرج رأسه إلي وهو معتكف فأغسله وأنا حائض
english_blocks: Qabisah related to us. He said: Sufyan related to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from al-Aswad, from ‘A’ishah, who said:

The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, and I used to bathe from one vessel while we were both in janabah. He would tell me to wrap myself with a waist cloth, and I would do so; then he would caress me while I was menstruating. He would extend his head towards me while he was in retreat, and I would wash it while I was menstruating.

arabic_blocks: [296] حدثنا إسماعيل بن خليل قال : أخبرنا علي بن مسهر قال : أخبرنا أبو إسحاق هو الشيباني عن عبد الرحمن بن الأسود عن أبيه عن عائشة قالت كانت إحدانا إذا كانت حائضا فأراد رسول الله ﷺ أن يباشرها أمرها أن تتزر في فور حيضتها ثم يباشرها قالت وأيكم يملك إربه كما كان النبي ﷺ يملك إربه تابعه خالد وجرير عن الشيباني
english_blocks: Isma‘il ibn Khalil related to us. He said: ‘Ali ibn Mushir informed us. He said: Abu Ishaq—who is al-Shaybani—informed us, from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Aswad, from his father, from ‘A’ishah, who said:

When one of us was menstruating and the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, wished to caress her, he told her to wrap herself with a waist cloth at the height of her menstrual flow; then he would caress her. She said: “Which of you can control his desire as the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, controlled his desire?”
Khalid and Jarir corroborated it, from al-Shaybani.
entries.english_status: Personal prototype: AI-assisted working translation; two Arabic printed witnesses and two English translation families compared. Independent Arabic, English and context review pending.

notes: The full chain retains Abu Ishaq’s identification as al-Shaybani. The historical print has حدثنا for Ali ibn Mushir, while the selected digital and modern print have أخبرنا; the selected informed us remains.

At the height of her menstrual flow is the working rendering of في فور حيضتها. arabic_blocks: [297] حدثنا أبو النعمان قال : حدثنا عبد الواحد قال : حدثنا الشيباني قال : حدثنا عبد الله بن شداد قال : سمعت ميمونة كان رسول الله ﷺ إذا أراد أن يباشر امرأة من نسائه أمرها فاتزرت وهي حائض  ، ورواه سفيان عن الشيباني

When the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, wished to caress one of his wives, he instructed her, and she wrapped herself with a waist cloth while she was menstruating.
And Sufyan related it from al-Shaybani.

arabic_blocks: [298] حدثنا سعيد بن أبي مريم قال : أخبرنا محمد بن جعفر قال : أخبرني زيد هو ابن أسلم عن عياض بن عبد الله عن أبي سعيد الخدري قال خرج رسول الله ﷺ في أضحى أو فطر إلى المصلى فمر على النساء ، فقال : يا معشر النساء تصدقن فإني أريتكن أكثر أهل النار فقلن وبم يا رسول الله قال تكثرن اللعن وتكفرن العشير ما رأيت من ناقصات عقل ودين أذهب للب الرجل الحازم من إحداكن قلن وما نقصان ديننا وعقلنا يا رسول الله قال أليس شهادة المرأة مثل نصف شهادة الرجل قلن بلى قال : فذلك نقصان من عقلها أليس إذا حاضت لم تصل ولم تصم قلن بلى قال : فذلك من نقصان دينها
english_blocks: Sa‘id ibn Abi Maryam related to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Ja‘far informed us. He said: Zayd—who is Ibn Aslam—informed me, from ‘Iyad ibn ‘Abd Allah, from Abu Sa‘id al-Khudri, who said:

The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, went out on Adha or Fitr to the prayer ground. He passed by the women and said: “Women, give charity, for I have been shown that you make up most of the people of the Fire.” They said: “And why, Messenger of Allah?” He said: “You curse often and are ungrateful to your husbands. I have not seen anyone deficient in intellect and religion who takes away the reason of a resolute man more than one of you.” They said: “What is the deficiency in our religion and intellect, Messenger of Allah?” He said: “Is not a woman’s testimony like half a man’s testimony?” They said: “Yes.” He said: “That is part of the deficiency in her intellect. Is it not the case that when she menstruates, she neither prays nor fasts?” They said: “Yes.” He said: “That is part of the deficiency in her religion.”

arabic_blocks: [299] حدثنا أبو نعيم قال : حدثنا عبد العزيز بن أبي سلمة عن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم عن القاسم بن محمد عن عائشة قالت خرجنا مع النبي ﷺ لا نذكر إلا الحج فلما جئنا سرف طمثت فدخل علي النبي ﷺ وأنا أبكي ، فقال : ما يبكيك قلت لوددت والله أني لم أحج العام قال لعلك نفست قلت : نعم قال : فإن ذلك شيء كتبه الله على بنات آدم فافعلي ما يفعل الحاج غير أن لا تطوفي بالبيت حتى تطهري
english_blocks: Abu Nu‘aym related to us. He said: ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn Abi Salamah related to us, from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Qasim, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from ‘A’ishah, who said:

We set out with the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, mentioning only the Hajj. When we came to Sarif, I menstruated. The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, came in to me while I was crying. He said: “What makes you cry?” I said: “By Allah, I wish I had not performed Hajj this year.” He said: “Perhaps you have begun menstruating?” I said: “Yes.” He said: “That is something Allah has ordained for the daughters of Adam. Perform what the pilgrim performs, except that you must not circumambulate the House until you become pure.”

arabic_blocks: [300] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال : أخبرنا مالك عن هشام بن عروة عن أبيه عن عائشة أنها قالت : قالت فاطمة بنت أبي حبيش لرسول الله ﷺ يا رسول الله إني لا أطهر أفأدع الصلاة ، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : إنما ذلك عرق وليس بالحيضة فإذا أقبلت الحيضة فاتركي الصلاة فإذا ذهب قدرها فاغسلي عنك الدم وصلي
english_blocks: ‘Abd Allah ibn Yusuf related to us. He said: Malik informed us, from Hisham ibn ‘Urwah, from his father, from ‘A’ishah, that she said:

Fatimah bint Abi Hubaysh said to the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace: “Messenger of Allah, I do not become pure. Shall I leave prayer?” The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “That is only a vein, and is not menstruation. When the menstrual period comes, leave prayer. When its duration has passed, wash the blood off yourself and pray.”

arabic_blocks: [301] حدثنا عبد الله بن يوسف قال : أخبرنا مالك عن هشام عن فاطمة بنت المنذر عن أسماء بنت أبي بكر أنها قالت سألت امرأة رسول الله ﷺ فقالت : يا رسول الله أرأيت إحدانا إذا أصاب ثوبها الدم من الحيضة كيف تصنع ، فقال رسول الله ﷺ : إذا أصاب ثوب إحداكن الدم من الحيضة فلتقرصه ثم لتنضحه بماء ثم لتصلي فيه
english_blocks: ‘Abd Allah ibn Yusuf related to us. He said: Malik informed us, from Hisham, from Fatimah bint al-Mundhir, from Asma’ bint Abi Bakr, that she said:

A woman asked the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, saying: “Messenger of Allah, tell me, if menstrual blood gets on the garment of one of us, what should she do?” The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said: “If menstrual blood gets on the garment of one of you, let her rub it with her fingers, then wash it with water, then pray in it.”

arabic_blocks: [302] حدثنا أصبغ قال : أخبرني ابن وهب قال : أخبرني عمرو بن الحارث عن عبد الرحمن بن القاسم حدثه عن أبيه عن عائشة قالت كانت إحدانا تحيض ثم تقترص الدم من ثوبها عند طهرها فتغسله وتنضح على سائره ثم تصلي فيه

One of us would menstruate, then, when she became pure, rub the blood from her garment, wash it and sprinkle water over the rest of it, then pray in it.

arabic_blocks: [303] حدثنا إسحاق قال : حدثنا خالد بن عبد الله عن خالد عن عكرمة عن عائشة أن النبي ﷺ اعتكف معه بعض نسائه وهي مستحاضة ترى الدم فربما وضعت الطست تحتها من الدم وزعم أن عائشة رأت ماء العصفر فقالت كأن هذا شيء كانت فلانة تجده
english_blocks: Ishaq related to us. He said: Khalid ibn ‘Abd Allah related to us, from Khalid, from ‘Ikrimah, from ‘A’ishah:

That one of the wives of the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, stayed in retreat with him while she had bleeding outside her menstrual period and was seeing blood. Sometimes she would place a basin beneath her because of the blood.
And he stated that ‘A’ishah saw safflower water and said: “It is as if this is something such-and-such a woman used to experience.”

arabic_blocks: [304] حدثنا قتيبة قال : حدثنا يزيد بن زريع عن خالد عن عكرمة عن عائشة قالت اعتكفت مع رسول الله ﷺ امرأة من أزواجه فكانت ترى الدم والصفرة والطست تحتها وهي تصلي
english_blocks: Qutaybah related to us. He said: Yazid ibn Zuray‘ related to us, from Khalid, from ‘Ikrimah, from ‘A’ishah, who said:

A woman among the wives of the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, stayed in retreat with him. She would see blood and yellow discharge, and the basin was beneath her while she prayed.

arabic_blocks: [306] حدثنا أبو نعيم قال : حدثنا إبراهيم بن نافع عن ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد قال : قالت عائشة ما كان لإحدانا إلا ثوب واحد تحيض فيه فإذا أصابه شيء من دم قالت بريقها فقصعته بظفرها
english_blocks: Abu Nu‘aym related to us. He said: Ibrahim ibn Nafi‘ related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, who said: ‘A’ishah said:
Each of us had only one garment in which she would menstruate. If some blood got on it, she applied her saliva to it and rubbed it off with her fingernail.

arabic_blocks: [307] حدثنا عبد الله بن عبد الوهاب قال : حدثنا حماد بن زيد عن أيوب عن حفصة قال أبو عبد الله أو هشام بن حسان عن حفصة عن أم عطية عن النبي ﷺ قالت كنا ننهى أن نحد على ميت فوق ثلاث إلا على زوج أربعة أشهر وعشرا ولا نكتحل ولا نتطيب ولا نلبس ثوبا مصبوغا إلا ثوب عصب وقد رخص لنا عند الطهر إذا اغتسلت إحدانا من محيضها في نبذة من كست أظفار وكنا ننهي عن اتباع الجنائز قال رواه هشام بن حسان عن حفصة عن أم عطية عن النبي ﷺ
english_blocks: ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Abd al-Wahhab related to us. He said: Hammad ibn Zayd related to us, from Ayyub, from Hafsah.
Abu ‘Abd Allah said: “Or Hisham ibn Hassan, from Hafsah.”
From Umm ‘Atiyyah, from the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. She said:

We were forbidden to mourn a dead person for more than three days, except for a husband: four months and ten days. We were not to apply kohl, use perfume or wear a dyed garment, except an ‘asb garment. When becoming pure, if one of us bathed after her menstruation, we were allowed a small amount of kust azfar. We were forbidden to follow funeral processions.
He said: Hisham ibn Hassan related it from Hafsah, from Umm ‘Atiyyah, from the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace.

arabic_blocks: [308] حدثنا يحيى قال : حدثنا ابن عيينة عن منصور بن صفية عن أمه عن عائشة أن امرأة سألت النبي ﷺ عن غسلها من المحيض فأمرها كيف تغتسل قال خذي فرصة من مسك فتطهري بها قالت كيف أتطهر قال تطهري بها قالت كيف قال سبحان الله تطهري فاجتبذتها إلي فقلت : تتبعي بها أثر الدم
english_blocks: Yahya related to us. He said: Ibn ‘Uyaynah related to us, from Mansur ibn Safiyyah, from his mother, from ‘A’ishah:

That a woman asked the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, about her washing after menstruation. He instructed her how to bathe. He said: “Take a piece of cloth with musk and purify yourself with it.” She said: “How do I purify myself?” He said: “Purify yourself with it.” She said: “How?” He said: “Glory be to Allah! Purify yourself.” I pulled her towards me and said: “Follow the trace of blood with it.”

notes: Every repeated question and response is retained, including the short final How? The EPUB omits one exchange; it is not used to shorten the selected report. The ending remains first person without adding a speaker label absent from that clause.

Piece of cloth with musk is a provisional rendering of فرصة من مسك. Fath al-Bari discusses both the cloth/material and musk-versus-leather readings. Both English comparison bodies use a perfumed cloth; the original unvocalized Arabic remains available and independent review is pending. The source’s short Yahya is not expanded into a disputed identity.
The historical print adds بها in the first question where the selected and modern body do not. The selected shorter question is preserved.

arabic_blocks: [309] حدثنا مسلم قال : حدثنا وهيب حدثنا منصور عن أمه عن عائشة أن امرأة من الأنصار قالت للنبي ﷺ كيف أغتسل من المحيض قال خذي فرصة ممسكة فتوضئي ثلاثا ثم إن النبي ﷺ استحيا فأعرض بوجهه أو قال توضئي بها فأخذتها فجذبتها فأخبرتها بما يريد النبي ﷺ
english_blocks: Muslim related to us. He said: Wuhayb related to us; Mansur related to us, from his mother, from ‘A’ishah:

That a woman of the Ansar said to the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace: “How do I bathe after menstruation?” He said: “Take a piece of cloth scented with musk and clean yourself three times.” Then the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, felt embarrassed and turned his face away.
Or he said: “Clean yourself with it.”
I took hold of her, pulled her towards me and told her what the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, meant.
entries.english_status: Personal prototype: AI-assisted working translation; two Arabic printed witnesses and two English translation families compared. Independent Arabic, English and context review pending.

notes: The phrase فتوضئي ثلاثا is provisionally rendered clean yourself three times, following the clause order and both English comparisons. Fath al-Bari also explains three as repetition of the spoken instruction. This ambiguity is disclosed separately, not presented as an independently settled translation.

The narrator’s explicit أو قال alternative is retained as a transmission note between the report portions. No anatomical detail from the EPUB’s explanatory brackets is added. The final taking hold, pulling closer and explanation all remain.
The historical print has a different conjunction before توضئي and an additional قال before Mansur’s reporting verb; selected wording agrees with the modern print and is retained.
